title_en: Birdman Soars to Underwood Victory at Caulfield
description: Chris Waller's redoubtable import Birdman staked his claim for the AU$6 million Cox Plate (G1) in notching his second elite success—in the space of three starts—in Caulfield Racecourse's Underwood Stakes (G1) Sept. 19.

title_en: Angel Capital Gets Elusive Group 1 in Sir Rupert Clarke
description: Angel Capital finally secured a deserved breakthrough at the highest level when producing a powerful finish to land the Sept. 19 Sir Rupert Clarke Stakes (G1) at Caulfield Racecourse.

title_en: Nyquist Colt Brings $1.2 Million at Keeneland
description: Hip 1686, a son of Nyquist consigned by Four Star Sales, was the first yearling through the ring to sell for seven figures Sept. 20 when bringing $1.2 million from Donato Lanni, agent for FRC, Starlight and Madaket.

title_en: Garcia, Rodriguez Sidelined After Churchill Spill
description: Jockeys Martin Garcia and Walter Rodriguez will both be off their mounts Sept. 20 and are expected to miss time following a spill at Churchill Downs Sept. 19.

title_en: Canterbury Park Concludes Season With Gains
description: Canterbury Park's 32nd season of live racing concluded Sept. 19 showing gains in attendance and on-track wagering during the 50-day meet.

title_en: Conceit Proves Worthy of Praise in Dogwood
description: Not This Time 3-year-old fillies grab attention Sept. 19 with Bodacious Bay taking the $1 million Cotillion Stakes (G1) at Parx Racing and Conceit the $300,000 Dogwood Stakes (G3) at Churchill Downs.

title_en: $1.5 Million Not This Time Colt Leads Book 3 Opener
description: A total of 276 horses changed hands for $62,870,000, including private sales. Gross sales fell from $65,327,000 at last year's corresponding session, though 21 fewer horses were traded. The average price was up 3.6% to $227,790.

title_en: BH In Session: Book 3 Begins at Keeneland September
description: On BH In Session: Keeneland September: Louie Rabaut continues recapping the Keeneland September Yearling Sale with several of the players.

title_en: Great Day at Keeneland for WinStar's Life Is Good
description: Life Is Good has translated his summer racetrack momentum straight into the sales ring, solidifying his status as a standout freshman sire for WinStar Farm. Hip 1412 sold for $1.25 million to St. Elias, West Point, Lane's End Racing, and Belladonna.

title_en: Spill at Churchill Causes Injuries; Declared No Contest
description: A six-horse accident in the second race at Churchill Downs Sept. 19 results in the 6 1/2-furlong race for maiden 2-year-olds being declared a "no contest" by Kentucky Horse Racing and Gaming Corporation stewards.

title_en: William T Upsets Maycocks Bay in Durham Cup
description: Supplemented William T surged late to upset heavy favorite Maycocks Bay and score his first career stakes win in the $143,662 Durham Cup Stakes (G3) Sept. 19 at Woodbine.

title_en: O'Callaghans Strike Big With $750K Honor A. P. Colt
description: The Sept. 19 opening session of Book 3 at the Keeneland September Sale started with a bang for Peter and Jenny O'Callaghan, who saw their pinhook—a colt by Honor A. P.—bring a final bid of $750,000 from CHC, Maverick Racing, and Light Post Ventures.

title_en: Cajun Caviar First Stakes Winner for LA Sire No Parole
description: Ellen Epstein's Cajun Caviar improves to 2-for-2 by capturing the Louisiana Cup Juvenile Fillies Stakes Sept. 19 at Louisiana Downs, becoming the first stakes winner for her sire No Parole.

title_en: Stradale Shines on Dirt in Gallant Bob at Parx
description: Turf or dirt, it doesn't seem to matter to Kaleem Shah's Stradale.

title_en: The Puma Prevails in Pennsylvania Derby
description: The Puma, under Javier Castellano, made a huge move around the far turn, opened up a couple of lengths through the stretch, and held off a late charge from Further Ado to win the Pennsylvania Derby (G1) Sept. 19 at Parx Racing.

title_en: Bodacious Bay Pays Off by Winning Cotillion
description: Racing Sept. 19 at Parx Racing in the Cotillion Stakes (G1), recent purchase Bodacious Bay pays immediate dividends for her new connections by defeating Always a Runner and Measure in the $1 million race for 3-year-old fillies.

title_en: Reza Romps, Becomes First Winner for Tale of Silence
description: Reza turned heads by breaking his maiden by 8 lengths with a last-to-first rally in his debut Sept. 19 at Gulfstream Park, becoming the first winner for freshman sire Tale of Silence.

title_en: Lady Finger, Aspirant Top Sept. 21 Card at Finger Lakes
description: New York-breds will take center stage in four stakes events Sept. 21 at Finger Lakes, topped by the $100,634 Lady Finger Stakes for 2-year-old fillies and the $99,615 Aspirant Stakes for 2-year-old males.

title_en: RTM Racing Buys Not This Time Colt for $1.5M
description: Shortly after the Keeneland September Yearling Sale had the first $1 million horse of its fifth session with Hip 1250, a second colt, a son of Not This Time consigned as Hip 1275, surpassed that figure in selling for $1.5 million to RTM Racing.

title_en: Qatar Racing Buys $1M Repole-Bred Into Mischief Colt
description: A colt by Into Mischief became the first seven-figure horse of the fifth session of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale when bloodstock agent Fergus Galvin purchased him for $1 million.

title_en: Half to In Our Time Set for Keeneland Sales Ring
description: When Laura's Pleasure was paired with Oscar Performance, it caught the attention of Neal Clarke of Bedouin Bloodstock. Then he got a look at their bay colt, which he is consigning Sept. 19 as Hip 1459 at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

description: A magical day saw Belmont Park open its doors for the first time in three years as a sold-out crowd of 6,000 wined, dined, and wagered its way through a memorable Sept. 18 afternoon.

title_en: Stone Farm Founder, Industry Shaper Hancock Dies at 83
description: Arthur Hancock III, who soared to the heights of Thoroughbred racing and breeding and is enshrined in the Racing Hall of Fame as a Pillar of the Turf, died Sept. 18 at his home near Paris, Ky., according to a family member. He was 83.

title_en: Forever Young Too Much for Foes in Jockey Club Gold Cup
description: Forever Young delivers as the heavy favorite in the $935,000 Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1) Sept. 18 at Belmont Park, comfortably winning the race in advance of an intended start in the $7 million Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) Oct. 31 at Keeneland.

title_en: Just Like Old Times for McGaughey as Belmont Park Opens
description: It was an auspicious start for Belmont Park and jockey Antonio Fresu, and just like old times for trainer Shug McGaughey.

title_en: New Zealand Oaks Winner Leica Lucy Retired From Racing
description: New Zealand Oaks (G1) winner Leica Lucy has been retired from racing following an unsuccessful return from fetlock surgery, bringing an end to a career that delivered six wins and more than NZ$1 million in prize money.

title_en: Sum of Success Connections Consider BC Juvenile Turf
description: K. Johnston Racing, Michael and Jules Iavarone, and Hopeless Stables' Gulfstream Park-based multiple stakes-winning 2-year-old Sum of Success, undefeated in three dirt starts, could make his turf debut next month on racing's biggest stage.

title_en: Shotgun Hottie Euthanized After Beginning to Founder
description: Graded stakes-winning millionaire Shotgun Hottie, less than a couple of years into her broodmare career, was euthanized this past weekend after beginning to founder, said Case Clay, racing manager for owner Wathnan Racing.

title_en: Major Players Look for Dismissal of CAW Lawsuit
description: A New York federal district court is considering dismissal of a lawsuit accusing several major players in the horse racing industry of engaging in racketeering and other unlawful activities related to betting by computer-assisted wagering companies.

title_en: Cubbies Root, Root, Root Act of Parliament to Victory
description: The Chicago Cubs of Major League Baseball flew the 'W' Sept. 17 at Churchill Downs when Alex Bregman's Act of Parliament rallied to win the final race of the evening with nearly the entire team there to celebrate.

title_en: Elliott 23rd North American Rider to Win 6,000 Races
description: A set of unexpected circumstances led to veteran jockey Stewart Elliott finally reaching the 6,000 North American victories milestone on the evening of Sept. 17 at Remington Park.

title_en: Baeza, Further Ado to Join Spendthrift Roster in 2027

title_en: Coup for India as G1 Winner Sosie Joins Poonawalla Stud
description: India's leading breeding operation, Poonawalla Stud, has secured four-time group 1 winner Sosie to stand as a stallion next year.

description: Classic-placed Arkansas Derby (G1) winner Sandman (Tapit—Distorted Music by Distorted Humor) will stand the upcoming breeding season at Rockridge Stud near Hudson, N.Y., it was announced Sept. 17.

description: The Louisiana Thoroughbred Breeders Association and Louisiana Downs will collectively award four scholarships, each valued at $1,000, on Sept. 19, Louisiana Cup Day.

description: Haras d'Etreham and Widden Stud have made a joint purchase to stand recent Irish Champion Stakes (G1) winner Hotazhell from 2027 onward.

description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Airdrie Stud's Upstart has a budding star in Pocahontas Stakes (G3) winner Manuka Honey.

description: Well-bred 2-year-olds Coach Pope and Endrush are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after notching swift maiden victories at Churchill Downs.

description: Hip 238 is the first foal out of Goodnight Olive. And just as there was ample anticipation for his birth, there might be even more for his appearance in the sales ring.

title_en: Devall, Breeder of Havnameltdown, Dies at 57
description: Katherine Devall, breeder of a pair of graded stakes winners, died Sept. 3 in Paintsville, Ky. The former resident of Lexington and Florida was 57.

description: Juddmonte Farms' dual champion male sprinter has seven cataloged in Book 1 of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale that begins Sept. 14.
